questions.q: What is the main difference between implementation work and production support work?
options: Support work never touches real transactions
Support consultants never need to understand setup
Implementation designs the system; support traces one real symptom back to its actual cause in a live system
Implementation is only done by Oracle, not consultants
questions.explain: Production support happens after the system is live: a real user hit a real problem, and the job is to trace the symptom back to its actual cause without disturbing what's currently working.

questions.q: Put these ticket stages in the correct order: Resolve, Triage, Investigate, Intake.
options: Intake, Triage, Investigate, Resolve
Triage, Intake, Resolve, Investigate
Investigate, Intake, Triage, Resolve
Intake, Resolve, Triage, Investigate
questions.explain: The six stages run Intake, Triage, Reproduce and Scope, Investigate, Resolve, Document and Close.

questions.q: A consultant 'fixes' a stuck invoice by loosening a tolerance setting that applies to every supplier in the business unit. What is the main risk?
options: Nothing — tolerance settings never affect other suppliers
The invoice will now take longer to pay
Oracle will block the change automatically
The fix likely trades one ticket for many new ones by changing behavior for transactions that were working correctly
questions.explain: A fix scoped wider than the actual root cause risks changing behavior for every other supplier or transaction that relied on the original setting.

questions.q: A ticket is marked Critical because the whole AP team is blocked. What does that severity rating tell you about the root cause?
options: The root cause must be complex, since many people are affected
Nothing on its own — a critical ticket can still have a very simple, narrow root cause
The root cause is guaranteed to be a security issue
Severity and root cause are always the same thing
questions.explain: Severity measures urgency and impact, not complexity. A Critical ticket can have a one-line root cause, like a single disabled account combination.

questions.q: In the Meridian Steel Fabricators example, what did the consultant do first after reading the ticket?
options: Immediately changed the supplier's payment terms
Escalated the ticket without investigating
Reproduced the problem themselves and read the actual message Oracle returned
Closed the ticket as a duplicate
questions.explain: Rather than guessing, the consultant reproduced the issue directly and read Oracle's actual message before drawing any conclusions.
